answer: Sustained-Attention Quorum: each identity keeps a mirror state of its last K interactions. A randomized beacon sends per-identity probes requiring context-correct replies within a jitter window; periodic glacier checks replay old mirror segments to enforce durable attention. Action rights decay on misses and need a fresh streak. An attacker running N sybils must supply N concurrent, non-multiplexable attention contexts under overlapping deadlines; one operator cannot fan out, so cost scales with real parallel attention and latency, not registration capital.
